title: What does that status mean?
description:
Turn status codes into advice for a client.

```
200 OK              success
201 Created         success
304 Not Modified    use your cached copy
400 Bad Request     fix the request; do not retry
401 Unauthorized    sign in again
404 Not Found       stop: the thing is not there
429 Too Many Requests  wait (Retry-After: 30 s), then retry
503 Service Unavailable  retry later with backoff
```
hints: `HTTPStatus(code).phrase` gives the name, so you only write the advice (lesson 1.02).
`500 <= status < 600` catches the whole range in one test.
requirements: `advise(status, headers)` returns a short piece of advice for every code above, and a sensible answer by range (2xx, 4xx, 5xx) for others.
`retryable(status)` is true only for 408, 429 and 5xx codes.
